# FastTrackr AI

> FastTrackr AI is an AI platform for financial-advisor transitions. It automates the paperwork-heavy work of moving a book of business between firms or custodians (repapering, account applications and transfer-of-asset (ACATS) forms) so books move in days, not months, with fewer not-in-good-order (NIGO) rejections.

## What FastTrackr is
- An AI transition engine that reads, validates and pre-fills the forms a repapering generates, catches NIGO-triggering errors before submission, and tracks every household and account through the move.
- Custodians: we support Fidelity, Charles Schwab, Goldman Sachs and SEI. BNY Pershing is coming soon.
- Paperwork goes out by one-click DocuSign, as filled PDFs, as Excel in the counterparty's own template, or straight to the custodian by API where it's supported.
- Pricing: transition pricing depends on your volumes and use case. Reach out to us to know more.

## Who it serves
- Transition consultants running repapering for advisors on the move.
- Breakaway advisors leaving a wirehouse or broker-dealer to go independent.
- Acquisitive RIAs absorbing books through mergers and tuck-ins.
- Independent broker-dealers and their OSJs.
- Custodians processing inbound transfers at scale.

## Proof points (as stated on-site)
- An advisor team moved $100M across 150 households in two weeks, with zero repapering NIGOs, starting from zero client data ([case study](https://fasttrackr.ai/case-study/advisor-transition)).
- A solo advisor going independent sent the paperwork for all 411 accounts before noon on day one ([case study](https://fasttrackr.ai/case-study/independent-breakaway-setup)).
- A team of four advisors moved $400M and 1,000+ accounts from a broker-dealer to their own RIA in nine days ([case study](https://fasttrackr.ai/case-study/bd-to-ria-400m-transition)).
- Industry estimate for the NIGO rate on transition paperwork: 15%.
Note: client results come from FastTrackr's published case studies.
